traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: The relative trueness study (Appendix 5, incubation 40-48h+72h) reports results by numeric "Category" (1, 2, 3) rather than by named food category; the exact food-type names for these numeric categories are not explicitly stated in the extracted pages (only sub-types 'a', 'b', 'c' with sample numbers are shown, and elsewhere in the report categories are named e.g. 'Meat and meat products - Pork sausage meat', 'Poultry and poultry products - White chicken meat', 'Environmental testing in food - Process water'). Because the raw appendix only labels them as Category 1/2/3 without explicit names on the visible pages, I used a generic placeholder description combining the known scope categories; true category-to-number mapping could not be confirmed with certainty from the provided pages. The 'All categories' aggregate row (n=68, bias 0.03, SD 0.31, CI -0.59/0.64) was excluded per instructions since it is a total, not an individual category. The Acceptability Limit is stated as +/- 0.5 log (see Figure 7 accuracy profile, AL=+/-0.5), though for some categories (white chicken meat, process water) an adjusted AL based on 4*SDref was computed (0.624 and 0.748 respectively) because the reference method's repeatability SD exceeded 0.125; these adjusted values are noted here but the primary stated AL is 0.5 log. Also note: the inter-laboratory study (section 3.2) used a different acceptability limit of ±1.16 log CFU/g and a different set of levels (Low/Medium/High) rather than food categories; this data was not included in the category table per instructions to focus on the primary method comparison (relative trueness) study.
